log.label: Sweep
log.reason: Frames 2:55 (both tangled in guard on the ground, no clear top) -> 3:00 (clean top position established) support a genuine sweep at this timestamp, but the scoreboard shows ANE's point cell going 0->2 at exactly 3:00, not Aurelie's (hers stays 0 until 4:45) -- actor swapped in the original reading.

log.label: Sweep
log.reason: Scoreboard confirms a real 2pt score at 4:45, and it belongs to AURELIE's cell (0->2), not Ane's as claimed -- so the actor is swapped here too. But the action itself is obscured: 4:30-4:40 is blocked by the referee standing in frame, and the 4:45 frame shows both athletes STANDING with one pursuing/chasing the other who is off-balance -- that reads more like a takedown scramble than a guard-to-top sweep reversal, and I cannot confirm which from a single 5s frame either side of the blackout. Real actor is knowable (Aurelie) but the technique itself is not confirmable at required confidence -> dropped rather than guessing sweep vs takedown.

log.label: Sweep
log.reason: No points change on the scoreboard anywhere near 7:20 -- Aurelie's cells go 2-2-0 (7:10) -> 2-3-0 (7:20), i.e. only an ADVANTAGE increment, not points; Ane's stay 2-0-1 throughout. A 'Sweep... points:2' claim here is unsupported by the one thing the board is authoritative for -> dropped.
